summary: RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) feature testing completed with 100% success. All 3 roles (superadmin, admin, reception) tested for login, navigation visibility, and access restrictions. Backend API permissions working correctly. Frontend route protection and redirects working as expected.
passed_tests: Superadmin Login: Credentials super@pumpfit.com / super123 work correctly
Superadmin Navigation: Sees all 6 nav items (Dashboard, Clientes, Calendario, Ventas, Mostrador, Usuarios)
Superadmin /user-management: Can access page and see all users with role badges
Superadmin /reception: Can access Mostrador page
Admin Login: Credentials admin@pumpfit.com / admin123 work correctly
Admin Navigation: Sees 5 nav items (Dashboard, Clientes, Calendario, Ventas, Mostrador) - NO Usuarios
Admin /user-management: Correctly redirected to / (dashboard)
Admin /reception: Can access Mostrador page
Admin /clients, /calendar, /sales: Can access all admin pages
Reception Login: Credentials mostrador@pumpfit.com / mostrador123 work correctly
Reception Redirect: On login, automatically redirected to /reception (not dashboard)
Reception Page: Has shift controls (Start/Close), Clientes tab, Ventas de Hoy tab
Reception /clients: Correctly redirected to /reception
Reception /sales: Correctly redirected to /reception
Reception /calendar: Correctly redirected to /reception
Reception /user-management: Correctly redirected to /reception
User Management: Shows all users with correct role badges (Super Admin, Administrador, Mostrador)
Backend GET /api/users: Admin can view users list but reception cannot (403)
Backend POST /api/users: Only superadmin can create users (admin gets 403)
Backend RBAC: require_admin allows admin/superadmin/reception, require_superadmin only superadmin, require_admin_or_above only admin/superadmin
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC implementation is clean and follows best practices
ProtectedRoute component correctly handles role-based redirects
StaffRedirect component properly redirects reception to /reception
getNavItems() in Layout.js correctly filters navigation based on role
Backend decorators (require_admin, require_superadmin, require_admin_or_above) work as expected
seed_data_creation: Users already exist from /api/init/admin - superadmin, admin, reception
context_for_next_testing_agent: RBAC fully tested and working. Three roles exist: superadmin (full access including user management), admin (access to all except user management), reception (only access to /reception page with shift management). Backend APIs enforce permissions at the decorator level. Frontend uses ProtectedRoute with allowedRoles prop for route protection.
